title: Captcha Verification
description: Captcha verification for new members. Cannot access any channel without verification.
autoSetupDesc: Automatically creates roles, channel and configures permissions
disableDesc: Disables captcha, reverts permissions and verifies all unverified members
setupWarning: Auto setup will change all channel permissions. Continue?
disableWarning: Captcha will be disabled, all permissions will be reset and unverified members will be verified. Continue?
